- When you clicked Sign, did you see any error banners in the portal?

We’ll aim to get a reproducible case and either a hotfix or a mitigation (e.g., force re-render + expire the duplicate claim).

From: dev_patel@redwood.ai
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 13:20:45 -0800
Subject: Re: Workday onboarding - e-sign form looks blank / account created twice

Thanks — I pulled the inbound webhook and the Workday PDF bytes. Two important findings:

1) The initial PDF payload from Workday has a content-type of application/octet-stream and a Content-Encoding header "gzip" but the Cloud PDF renderer path is not decompressing in the rare case where Workday sets chunked encoding + gzip. That results in a 0-byte render on the client (white page).

2) The second attempt was the vendor retrying; because the claim flow is time-based (30 min window) and we accept new claims if the email normalization differs (we normalize dots vs underscores differently from Workday), the portal created a second claimed profile instead of reconciling.

I attached the log snippet and a base64 checksum of the PDF payload we received. Proposed mitigation:
- Immediately: mark the second claim as "suspended" in the portal to prevent PO routing until we reconcile (Marissa, can you suspend?).
- Short-term (24h): update the PDF ingestion to handle gzip+chunked edge case (small code change).
- Medium-term: tighten the email normalization rules to mirror Workday canonicalization and add a dedupe check during the claim flow.

I will open a jira (SUP-1983) with the root cause and patch plan. ETA for the ingestion fix: 8 hours (will push hotfix to staging then prod if tests pass).

Attachments: workday-onboard-log-snippet.txt

—Dev
